notes.title: Feedback-Based Hotfix
notes.content:
[p]We sincerely thank you for all the feedback you've sent us since yesterday's Early Access release.[/p][p]We've proceeded with a patch for the parts that urgently needed fixing.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch Contents[/p][list][*][p]Windowed mode resolution refinement[/p][/*][*][p]Relaxed basic job ending conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed GPU load issue in ending collection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some speaker display errors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Although the game still has many shortcomings,[/p][p]we thank all of you who played it once again,[/p][p]and we will continue to listen to your valuable feedback and make improvements.[/p][p]
Thank you.[/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed GPU load issue in ending collection
